paper_title: First indirect detection constraints on axions in the Solar basin
notes: Paper (DeRocco et al. 2022, arXiv:2205.05700) sets first indirect-detection limits on Solar basin axions decaying to X-rays, using NuSTAR quiescent solar limb observations. Main results in Fig. 2 constrain g_agamma (with g_aee=0) at 90% CL for m = 5-30 keV (plot extends to ~40 keV), reaching roughly an order of magnitude below the HB star cooling bound (g_agamma ~ 6.6e-11 GeV^-1). No numerical table is provided in the text; the data_points above are approximate values read off the described Fig. 2 exclusion curve (CLs/Yellin envelope) and should be replaced by digitized values from the paper's GitHub repository if precision is needed. The paper also constrains g_aee and the f_a plane (Figs. 1, 3), but the primary standalone coupling result is the photon coupling. Not a DM haloscope; no local DM density assumed (basin density is computed from solar production). | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.55, 9))
